agent_visible.software_contract: review_schedule(request) validates the entire request or raises ValueError without mutating it; exception text is not fixed. It returns equipment_count (number of equipment items), requirement_count (number of raw requirement records), current, proposed and changes. Each of current/proposed contains windows, conflict_weight, separated_weight and conflicts. A conflict is a positive-total-weight equipment pair assigned to the same window. Repeated/reversed requirements add weights; zero-total pairs are omitted from conflict lists. conflict_weight sums same-window weights; separated_weight sums different-window weights. Proposed windows must globally minimize conflict_weight. Ties choose the smallest sum of 2**i over equipment input positions i in window 0, regardless of the current arrangement; minimum movement is NOT an objective. All output windows list names in equipment input order, even if input current_windows used another order. Conflict records have first, second and weight; endpoints and records are ordered by their equipment positions i<j, then increasing (i,j). changes contains moved_equipment (records with equipment, from_window, to_window, ordered by equipment input order; window indices are 0 and 1), conflict_reduction (current minus proposed conflict_weight), resolved_conflicts (current conflict records absent in proposed), and introduced_conflicts (proposed conflict records absent in current). The latter lists retain conflict ordering. Conflicts that remain are exactly proposed.conflicts. Zero improvement does not imply no moves. Empty equipment requires current_windows=[[],[]] and yields empty lists and zero scores/counts. The valid JSON CLI reads one request from stdin and prints one report; invalid input produces no successful report and a nonzero exit. No approximate score, arbitrary tie choice, input mutation or omitted reporting is permitted.

agent_visible.title: Participant-aware agenda review
agent_visible.software_contract: review_agenda(request) validates the whole request before processing, raises ValueError for invalid inputs (message unspecified), and never mutates it. Sessions sharing any participant cannot occupy the same slot. Output contains session_count, current, preview, proposed, status and moves. A described arrangement contains assignment in session input order, unassigned session IDs, conflicts (each pair in input order with first/second IDs and sorted shared participant names), feasible (all sessions assigned and no conflicts), and slots (all slots in declared order, each with slot and its session IDs in input order). mode=inspect reports current only: preview/proposed are null, status=inspected, moves=[]. In complete mode, preserve an already feasible current arrangement exactly, status=retained and preview=null. Otherwise construct a preview by taking the earliest slot available for each session in session order, without revisiting preceding choices. A completed preview is {status:ready, assignment:[slot names]}, becomes proposed, and yields status=preview. If preview blocks, retain {status:blocked, assignment:null}; find an arrangement satisfying all participant restrictions, choosing the lexicographically smallest slot-index vector. If found, report status=completed and its proposed description; if none exists, report status=unavailable and proposed=null. Preview blockage alone does not mean no arrangement exists. Failed previews and partial current arrangements impose no fixed assignments on completion. moves lists changed sessions in input order with session_id/from/to, only when a proposal exists. Empty sessions are feasible, including with zero slots. Nonempty sessions with zero slots cannot be completed. CLI reads a JSON request and prints one JSON report; invalid requests exit nonzero without a successful report.

agent_visible.title: Named balance-system review
agent_visible.software_contract: review(request) validates a dense square system then reports current residual. solve mode uses partial-pivoted elimination (largest absolute pivot, first index tie) and back substitution, raises ValueError on exact zero pivot or detected numerical overflow, and returns named float solution, deltas and proposed residual. inspect does not solve and need not reject a singular matrix. Residual vector is Ax-b. scaled_backward_error is its infinity norm divided by machine epsilon*(||A||inf*||x||inf+||b||inf)*n. Zero/zero is 0; nonzero/zero is null. within_requested_limit compares the proposed scaled diagnostic to caller residual_limit; not a quantum-semantic acceptance criterion. Empty system yields empty solution and zero residual. No mutation. This is a small serial Python program, not a compliant HPL performance run.
